description:
Decode a UN packaging mark part by part: packaging code, performance level, density or gross mass, test pressure, year, state and maker, for packagings, IBCs, large packagings, salvage and reconditioned marks.
Use when: the user has read a mark off a drum, jerrican, box or IBC. Instead: un_number_packaging to find which codes a substance may use; ibc_inspection_dates for an IBC's test dates.
Inputs: mark alone decodes. Adding un also checks whether that container may carry that substance under ADR 2025, density included, returned as check. A bare code such as 3H1 decodes to its meaning only. If the user has not read the mark, ask for it rather than describing the container.
Returns: parts with the meaning of each, code, spec, noun (what the code describes), notes and source.
Behaviour: read-only; the same input gives the same answer. A string it cannot read as a mark returns ok:false.
Constraints: no authentication, key or headers. At most 10 requests per 10 seconds per IP address; above that HTTP 429, so space out repeated calls.
Each answer also lists the Fortitude21 containers made to that code (our_range) and carries publisher with a quote_url.

mark.description: The mark as printed, parts separated by slashes, e.g. "UN 3H1/Y1.9/150/26/D/BAM 12345" or an IBC mark "31HA1/Y/03 22/D/BAM 12345/10800/1200"

un.description: Optional UN number (four digits) to check the container against, e.g. "1203"

name: decode_un_packaging_mark

assumed.description: Each value the tool inferred or defaulted, in words, so it can be checked with the user

check.description: With un: whether the container may carry that substance, and why

cite.description: Credit line with a link, for quoting the answer

error.description: When ok is false: what is missing or could not be read, and what to send instead

notes.description: Points to watch for this mark

noun.description: What the code describes, e.g. plastic jerrican, non-removable head

ok.description: true with an answer. false when the tool needs one more input or cannot answer; error then says what to send

our_range.description: Fortitude21 containers made to this code

parts.description: Each part of the mark with its meaning

publisher.description: Who publishes the tool, the Fortitude21 products that fit, with links, and quote_url, a link to ask for a quotation

spec.description: The code with its performance level

tool.description: Link to the same answer on the interactive tool page

title: Decode a UN packaging mark
